clips.title: The story
paras: The Star, the Hand and the Heart is an Undercity quest wherein Keeper Bel'dugur tests an aspiring leader seeking to establish a new chapter of their order. To earn the essential Yagyin's Digest, the petitioner must track down three items of power whose names Bel'dugur dares not speak aloud.

Within the shadowed corridors of the Undercity, ambitious practitioners seeking to lead their own circle turn to Keeper Bel'dugur. To establish a new flock and open a chapter of their order, an aspiring leader requires Yagyin's Digest, an authoritative text of ritual lore guarded by the keeper. Bel'dugur stands ready to support his fellow brother, but demands proof of worthiness before yielding such authority.

Keeper Bel'dugur will not part with Yagyin's Digest lightly. He requires three distinct items of power to fulfill his side of the exchange. These relics carry such perilous or sacred significance that their names cannot even be spoken aloud; Bel'dugur instead pens them onto a private note. Only a practitioner capable of tracking down and retrieving all three unspoken artifacts proves worthy of founding their own chapter.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You need Yagyin's Digest? Your plan, then, is to gather another flock? Of course it is...and of course I will help you, friend.
But you must help me too.
I require three items of power. Bring me these and the digest will be yours.
I cannot utter the names of these items, but I will write them down.
Get me the items on this list. If you can do that, then you are truly worthy of opening your own chapter of our order.
